endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ks_friends_kaw_st_george_boggs_landing_access_20260919 friends-kaw-st-george-boggs-landing-river-mile-137: Friends of the Kaw's current Kansas River access page identifies the St. George/Boggs Landing Access Ramp at river mile 137 in Pottawatomie County and publishes GPS 39.18726,-96.42202, exactly matching the shared route coordinate. The page describes a one-vehicle concrete ramp, parking, restrooms, and the city/community-developed public access. The City of St. George independently lists Boggs Landing Boat Ramp, and Kansas Department of Wildlife & Parks' access-point guide lists St. George/Boggs Landing at river mile 137. Treat the published GPS as the public ramp/access-area anchor, not a surveyed wet-toe coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ks_friends_kaw_st_george_boggs_landing_access_20260919 friends-kaw-st-george-boggs-landing-river-mile-137) on Kansas River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
